rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance – rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Units fully covered by Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance are subject to rent control, which limits rent increases. This guide does not state the allowable increase amount.
rules.coverage_conditions: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single-family homes whose current tenancy began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually under separate leases). Includes units with Section 8 vouchers, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME, Berkeley Housing Trust Fund and similar subsidies, and certain project-based subsidies where there is no HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage.
rules.exemptions: New construction (units built with a Certificate of Occupancy issued after June 1980); single-family homes with a tenancy that began on or after Jan 1, 1996; most condominiums; Section 202 and Section 811 units; Rental Supplement, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or project-based Section 8 units in projects with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage. Fully exempt from the ordinance: Golden Duplexes (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy began; tenancies starting after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university housing such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Single-family homes and condominiums are covered only if the current tenancy began before 1996 (condo coverage 'most' excluded); exclusions depend on subsidy type and HUD mortgage status, shared kitchen/bath, ADU owner occupancy, and dorm/cooperative status.

rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.conflict_note: The guide describes the cutoff two ways: 'built before 1980' and new construction 'built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980.' The cutoff used here is a Certificate of Occupancy on or before June 30, 1980. The guide gives no municipal code citation, effective date, or rent increase amount.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause protections
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered units in Berkeley may evict only for a just cause listed in the ordinance. This applies to both fully and partially covered units, including new construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, and most condominiums.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units: multifamily units built before 1980; new construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes regardless of when the tenancy began; rooming houses; most condominiums; Section 202/811 units and other listed subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplexes (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies starting after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university housing such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exemptions depend on owner occupancy (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU), tenancy start date, and dorm or nonprofit cooperative status.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully and partially covered Berkeley rental units must pay tenants interest on security deposits. This guide does not state the interest rate.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units under the ordinance, including new construction, single-family homes, most condominiums, and the listed subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplexes; owner-shared kitchen/bath units where the owner lived on the property when the tenancy began; tenancies starting after Nov 7, 2018 on owner-occupied ADU properties; university housing such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exemptions depend on owner occupancy, tenancy start date, and dorm or nonprofit cooperative status.
